title: A Stranger in San Diego
medalDescription: You listened to the whispers of San Diego and learned the name that everyone is talking about.
description: A present-day Filipino college student finds themselves in 1887 San Diego — the fictional town from José Rizal's Noli Me Tangere. Establish your cover identity, overhear the gossip about last night's reception, and witness the man everyone is talking about.
introText: You find yourself at the edge of a town you don't recognize. The year, you'll soon learn, is 1887.
